updates.evidence: Frozen worlds distinguish exact aliases, versions, derivations, unresolved possible aliases and genuinely disjoint entities before saturation independence is counted.
updates.implementation: EvidenceIdentityLedger + IdentityAwareSaturationTracker; deterministic exact-alias canonicalization, transitive version/derivation ancestry, unresolved-identity partial state, conservative disjoint-lineage counting.
updates.remaining_gap: Identity relations are supplied as assertions. RAKL still needs authority/evidence levels for claims such as exact content identity versus metadata-only alias declarations.

updates.evidence: GitHub pull_request execution normally checks the synthesized merge subject, while workflow_run head_sha/source metadata names the source head. Git and Software Heritage also distinguish tree/content state from revision/history identity.
updates.remaining_gap: Need parent-controlled attestation of source commit, base commit, integration commit/tree and actually executed commit/tree without trusting candidate-produced metadata.

updates.problem: Typed identity relations are useful only if their evidence strength is explicit. A normalized DOI/URL, metadata relation, content hash, trusted repository statement and empirically verified record overlap do not have equal authority.
updates.target: Add evidence-bearing identity assertions with authority/scope and cannot-check states; exact identity must state which object layer is identical and why.
required_known_answer_worlds: same DOI string with changed mutable landing content does not imply byte identity
trusted IsIdenticalTo metadata links exact research output without collapsing a distinct version relation
matching content hash can establish content identity while revision/history identity remains distinct
conflicting alias assertions preserve both evidence packets and remain unresolved

updates.note: Identity/ancestry normalization determines whether full independence is established; it still does not justify arbitrary fractional information credit under dependence.
